_comment: Initial JavaScript per entry, gzip bytes: the client entry, its static-import closure and the route's lazy chunks (scripts/perf-budget.ts). The largest language catalogue chunk (loaded for the active language, phase 10b task 7b) counts in every entry. Each budget is the measurement + ~3 kB (phase 10b task 7b; it was + 15 % after the named lazy splits of phase 9 task 6); deploy-guard fails over it and hints to lower it when it sits more than 10 % above measured + 15 %. `target` is ruling 4's 200 kB (home) / 300 kB (any route); the shared closure that blocks it is in `note`. `workerGzip` is the Worker's hard cap (5 MiB).

home.note: Target not reached: the shared closure is ~455 kB gzip (the TanStack/React entry 132 kB, @smog/ui-web 104 kB, the active i18n catalogue 30 kB, the zod schemas 26 kB), none of it in this task's files.
